summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullish bets on NVDA and SPX, evidenced by massive call premiums in NVDA ($1.27B BuyCall vs $125M BuyPut) and extreme SPX call dominance (P/C 0.44). There is high-conviction accumulation in NVDA 160C and 200C (exp 2027) totaling over $1.5B, alongside persistent, multi-day aggressive buying of SPX 7000C strikes for late 2026. Traders should monitor for continued upward momentum in NVDA and SPX, but watch for potential volatility or hedging if the massive SPX 8000P ($195.8M) positions begin to scale alongside the 7000C accumulation.
